features.name: overall_morphology_severity
features.description: Equal-weight min-max clipped average across all nine cytology measurements; higher values indicate broader morphological abnormality.
features.expected_model_benefit: Dense monotone signal for a linear SVM margin, useful when many measurements rise together.

features.name: uniformity_average_severity
features.description: Average of normalized cell size and cell shape uniformity readings, emphasizing coordinated uniformity deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces two correlated columns into one smooth axis, helping the linear SVM handle collinearity.

features.name: uniformity_size_shape_gap
features.description: Absolute normalized disagreement between cell size and cell shape uniformity readings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds an imbalance direction that can receive an independent linear weight apart from average uniformity.

features.name: nuclear_prominence_score
features.description: Composite normalized nuclear morphology score from bare nuclei, chromatin, and nucleoli readings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses nuclear morphology into a stable continuous component for margin placement.

features.name: epithelial_adhesion_size_score
features.description: Average normalized marginal adhesion and single epithelial cell size, capturing cohesion and epithelial size pattern.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a low-noise epithelial structure axis complementary to nuclear and uniformity scores.

features.name: mitotic_activity_log_score
features.description: Log-scaled mitoses reading, clipped between observed training-fold minimum and maximum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses right-skewed mitotic readings into a smoother scale that is easier for linear margins to use.

features.name: uniformity_joint_elevation
features.description: Product of normalized cell size and cell shape uniformity readings; high values require both readings to be elevated.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM an explicit co-elevation term without requiring the model to infer multiplication.

features.name: multifocal_highness_soft_count
features.description: Smooth fraction of measurements in a mid-to-high cytology range using a ramp from 4 to 8 on the original measurement scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates a count of high readings while remaining continuous, producing a useful burden-like linear feature.
features.formula: ((np.clip((Clump_Thickness - 4.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((Cell_Size_Uniformity - 4.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((Cell_Shape_Uniformity - 4.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((Marginal_Adhesion - 4.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((Single_Epi_Cell_Size - 4.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((Bare_Nuclei - 4.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((Bland_Chromatin - 4.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((Normal_Nucleoli - 4.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0) + np.clip((Mitoses - 4.0) / 4.0, 0.0, 1.0)) / 9.0)

features.name: zscore_atypia_projection
features.description: Weighted average of clipped z-scores using training-fold means and standard deviations, preserving signed direction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a centered signed projection that is already scaled for margin optimization.

features.name: bare_nuclei_uniformity_ratio
features.description: Clipped ratio of bare nuclei reading to the average cell uniformity reading with a small stabilizing offset.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights disproportionate nuclear elevation relative to uniformity, adding a ratio direction for a linear boundary.

features.name: expert_pattern_coherence_score
features.description: Numeric assessment from 0 to 10 of how coherently the nine measurements form a diffuse atypia pattern: 0 for uniformly low values near baseline, 10 for multiple high cellular and nuclear readings that rise together; use only the row values and fixed training-fold context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures holistic morphology that may not be fully represented by pairwise arithmetic features.

features.name: expert_measurement_plausibility_score
features.description: Numeric assessment from 0 to 1 of internal measurement plausibility: 1 for mutually consistent, in-range cytology values; 0 for isolated spikes, contradictions, or boundary artifacts.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the margin a separate reliability axis so inconsistent rows can be weighted differently.
